problem.title: Is there a way to include a comment in an f-string?
problem.description: It would be useful for mo to include a comment in an f-string. For instance, take this code: f""" bla """ It would be nice if this code was equivalent to: f""" bla """ You can include full Python expressions in between the curly brackets, but it looks like you can't include comments. Am I correct? Is there a way to do this?
